text: Having bathed in the waters of the Ganges and having worshipped You, O Omnipresent Lord, with pure flowers and fruits, and having fixed my meditation upon the object of contemplation at the base of a stone seat in a mountain cave; delighting in the Self, subsisting on fruits, and devoted to the words of the Guru—O Enemy of Kamadeva, when shall I be liberated from suffering through the service of You, the one with equal hands and feet?
